<section class="white" id="meet"><div class="wrap split">
<div class="story">
<div class="section-kicker">Who is Kelly Hamilton?</div>
<h2>Why this Waterford mom decided it was time to get involved.</h2>
<p>I’m a Waterford graduate, local Realtor, small business owner, community advocate, and most importantly, a mom of three children who all attend Waterford schools. Waterford has been home for most of my life. I grew up here, graduated here, built my career here, and now I’m raising my own family here.</p>
<p>I’ve spent years working with families throughout our community and organizing free local events that bring neighbors and businesses together. <strong>I’m invested in Waterford far beyond this election, and that’s ultimately what pushed me to put my name on the ballot.</strong></p>
<p>I’m running for the Waterford Board of Education because I believe listening comes before leading. I want more consistent opportunities for parents, teachers, staff, students, business owners and residents to be heard — not only during an election or at a board meeting.</p>
</div>
